title: Add the git handoff block to done and blocked run envelopes
action: In run.rs add `fn git_block(cwd: &Path, main_root: &Path) -> Option<Value>` built on `crate::verbs::worktree::git::run_git` (git.rs:85; make it pub(crate) if it is not already reachable). Reads, in order: `rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` (a failure or a non-`true` answer returns None — the key is then absent, no-new-key law); `rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` → branch; `rev-parse HEAD` → head_sha; main HEAD via `run_git(main_root, ["rev-parse","HEAD"])` then `merge-base HEAD <main_sha>` → base_sha (copies merge.rs:214); `rev-list --count <base>..HEAD` → ahead (u64); `status --porcelain` → dirty (bool, non-empty) and its paths; `diff --name-only <base>..HEAD` → paths. changed_paths = sorted union of the diff paths and the porcelain paths (porcelain lines strip the two status columns and a leading space; a rename `a -> b` keeps b). Attach key `git` = {branch, head_sha, base_sha, ahead, dirty, changed_paths} in result_envelope (run.rs:2840) only for outcome done or blocked and only when git_block returns Some (D6 e0f6b8b5). Worker-reported `files_changed` stays untouched beside it. Tests: a temp git repo with one commit ahead and one dirty file yields the block with ahead 1, dirty true, changed_paths containing both; a non-git temp dir yields no key; a died envelope never carries the key.

truths: the git key appears only on done/blocked and only when cwd is a git checkout
changed_paths is the union of committed diff and porcelain paths
base_sha is the merge-base with the main checkout HEAD
key_links: run_git in verbs/worktree/git.rs is the one git reader
prohibitions: Six read-only git commands, no write
